name: splice-delta-location-selection
body: Limit: the splice delta selects only nodes whose location path is in the re-emission target set, so a located row with no location — a planned placeholder included — is never selected for the located kinds, and a declaration whose file is cached/unchanged is never re-emitted. The placeholder-masking over cached declarations is demonstrated reachable through ordinary CLI sequences: a still-planned located seed row stays planned even where its assembly holds the real declaration at that FQN. Upgrade: add the delta/seed heal that admits a planned seed row whose assembly holds the real declaration.
